policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: Scored like the other Red-White-Red routes, with a capital floor on top. Two different euro figures appear for different things — founding capital and additional investment capital — so each is labelled for what it funds.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as Singapore's MOM and the US ESTA pages already live.
not_extracted: THE POINTS TABLE. Its criterion-to-score mapping does not survive normalization — rows flatten so that criteria and their scores become separate consecutive lines, and the association exists only in visual layout. The THRESHOLD is quoted where the page states it in prose, because that is a sentence; the individual scores are not, because reconstructing them would be inference.
